Keep spend in check and bill usage early: spend limits that the access check enforces, alerts with a state per threshold, credit runway, automatic top-up, invoices raised when unbilled usage reaches an amount, a preview of a rate change on real usage, and an embeddable usage widget for your own app.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/auto_topup`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage-controls/retrieve-a-customer-s-automatic-top-up) | Retrieve a customer's automatic top-up |
| `PUT` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/auto_topup`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage-controls/set-a-customer-s-automatic-top-up) | Set a customer's automatic top-up |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/auto_topup/disable`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage-controls/turn-off-a-customer-s-automatic-top-up) | Turn off a customer's automatic top-up |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/auto_topup/enable`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage-controls/turn-on-a-customer-s-automatic-top-up) | Turn on a customer's automatic top-up |
